For managed models, you can use curl commands to send requests to the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform endpoint using the following model names: For Grok 4.6, use grok-4.6 For Grok 4.3, use grok-4.3 For Grok 4.20 (Reasoning), use grok-4.20-reasoning For Grok 4.20 (Non-reasoning), use grok-4.20-non-reasoning For Grok 4.1 Fast (Reasoning), use grok-4.1-fast-reasoning For Grok 4.1 Fast (Non-reasoning), use grok-4.1-fast-non-reasoning
